description: T-5123 (SPEC-0039 E6, hand shape): one delete_row of rows 4-7 (count 4), every data row of a table whose kept data row holds a calculated column: which cells of the kept row does Excel clear (the engine clears the calculated cell too)? Sales on S!B3:D7 (header B3:D3 Region/Qty/Dbl, data rows 4-7 Qty 1,2,4,8; Dbl is a calculated column, calculatedColumnFormula Sales[[#This Row],[Qty]]*2, stored in D4:D7), S!C10 99 below it. Sheet F reads sheet row 4 through whole-column references a row delete does not move: A1 =ROWS(Sales), A2 =SUM(Sales[Dbl]), A3 =COUNTA(Sales[Region]), A4 =INDEX(S!C:C,4) and A5 =ISBLANK(INDEX(S!C:C,4)) (the kept row's Qty cell), A6 =INDEX(S!D:D,4), A7 =ISBLANK(INDEX(S!D:D,4)), A8 =ISFORMULA(INDEX(S!D:D,4)) and A9 =FORMULATEXT(INDEX(S!D:D,4)) (the kept row's calculated cell), A10 =S!C10, A11 FORMULATEXT(A10) (how far the cells below move), A12 =FORMULATEXT(INDEX(S!D:D,5)) (the row below the kept one).
